subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding a function as a rule that assigns exactly one output to each input
source_inspiration: adapted from Japan MEXT Courses of Study sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student tests input-output machine scenarios to determine if each input produces exactly one output
exercise.pictorial: Student identifies which of several pictured mappings represents a valid function
exercise.abstract: Student determines whether a given relation (table, graph, or mapping) represents a function

misconception_flags: accepts a relation as a function even when one input maps to multiple outputs

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
